imageTag.description: Override image tag. Defaults to the chart appVersion.

gridCentralUrl.description: Base URL of upstream grid-central (in-namespace by default).

modelRepoUrl.description: HTTPS URL of a public Git repo containing the DSO grid model JSON. Required when mode=dso.

modelRepoBranch.description: Branch to track for the model repo.

modelPath.description: Path to the model JSON inside the repo.

assetId.description: Override the external-tie asset_id (defaults to the value from the model JSON).

upstreamBusId.description: Outer-grid bus ID whose voltage DSO should use as its slack V_setpoint. Picks one of the available PQ buses on the IEEE-9 topology (bus 1 is slack, 2 and 3 are generators, 5 hosts datacenter). Set assetId to match (e.g. bus 7 → dso-7) so grid-central's ASSET_BUS_MAP routes the injection to the right bus.

upstreamPollSeconds.description: Interval for polling upstream grid-central state.

ingressEnabled.description: Expose the zone HTTP UI via Ingress.

tlsEnabled.description: Issue an LE certificate via cert-manager when ingress is enabled.

tlsClusterIssuer.description: cert-manager ClusterIssuer used for the certificate.
